name: Review request: delivered, waited, asked once

nodes.name: Look up existing orders
nodes.notes: Read once per event, not once per item. alwaysOutputData so an empty queue does not stop the first order being added.

nodes.name: Queue (upsert on orderId)
nodes.notes: Only new orders reach this node. Still appendOrUpdate rather than append, so two copies of an event arriving at the same moment collapse into one row. RAW so sendAfter stays a plain yyyy-MM-dd string and is not turned into a locale-formatted date.

nodes.name: Hourly sweep
nodes.notes: Hourly, not daily, so each recipient can be sent inside their own civil hours rather than ours.

nodes.name: Read suppression list
nodes.notes: Unsubscribes and anyone who already left a review. Read every run, never cached. executeOnce so it is read once, not once per queue row (that would hit the Sheets quota), and alwaysOutputData so an empty list does not stop every send.

parameters.subject: =How are you getting on with your {{ $json.product || 'order' }}?
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.firstName || 'there' }},

You ordered {{ $json.product ? 'the ' + $json.product : 'from us' }} a week ago, so you have had a proper go with it by now.

If you have two minutes, a short review genuinely helps other people decide: https://example.com/review/{{ $json.orderId }}

And if it is not right, reply to this email and we will sort it. That matters more than the review.

Thanks,
The team

No more review requests: https://example.com/unsubscribe/{{ $json.orderId }}

nodes.name: Send review request
nodes.notes: Offers a fix before it asks for a review, and carries a one-click opt out. Asking an unhappy customer for a public review is how you buy a one-star.

nodes.name: Mark sent
nodes.notes: Straight after the send step. Only rows Gmail confirmed are marked, keyed on the queue row's own orderId (the Gmail output has none).
